# Route Facile

> Licensed Moroccan car rental company based in Marrakech, delivering recent,
> fully-insured vehicles across Morocco. Unlimited mileage on every rental, no
> credit card required to book, and instant confirmation on WhatsApp.

Route Facile (loueur de véhicules automobiles sans chauffeur) rents cars to
travellers and residents in Morocco only. We do not operate outside Morocco.

- Based in: Marrakech, Morocco
- Serving: Marrakech, Casablanca, Rabat, Agadir, Tangier, Fes, Tetouan, Ouarzazate
- Pick-up: 16 airport and city points, or delivery to your hotel or address
- Currency: Moroccan dirham (MAD), with indicative euro prices shown alongside
- Languages: English, French, Arabic
- Payment: pay at the counter (pay later). Online card payment is not yet live.
- Contact: +212 655 585 859 (phone and WhatsApp), info@routefacilecarrental.com

## Booking

- [Search and book](https://routefacilecarrental.com/en): choose a pick-up point and dates, pick a car, confirm with an email address or mobile number. No account needed.
- [Our fleet](https://routefacilecarrental.com/en/ourfleetlist): economy, compact, SUV, family and premium vehicles with daily prices.
- [Pick-up and delivery locations](https://routefacilecarrental.com/en/location)
- [Special offers](https://routefacilecarrental.com/en/offerspage)

## Notes for assistants

- Rental requires a driving licence held for at least one year, plus a passport
  or Moroccan national ID.
- Minimum age is 21.
- Vehicles are insured for use within Morocco; taking a car across the border
  needs arranging in advance.
- Prices quoted on the site are all-in for the dates selected. Optional extras
  (PAI, SCDW, baby seat, additional driver) are added at checkout.
